scope: T3b: native opaque-depth camera-motion diagnostics, not TAA or an SDK-ready composited frame
hardware: Linux x86-64; AMD Radeon 880M Graphics (RADV STRIX1); Vulkan; radv; Mesa 26.2.5-arch1.1

settings.requires: resolved HDR; unsupported/disabled HDR resolves diagnostics to off with a note
settings.extra_depth_store_bandwidth: not isolated; accounted inside opaque raster, outside the motion scope
settings.generated_frame_simulation_or_history_ad: not implemented; only submitted real frames commit previous camera

gpu_oracle.cases: standalone depth-gradient oracle plus real regular/conforming terrain, Low/High mesh shaders, rough fallback and loaded water material, spectral ocean admission, reset, resize, exposure and projection changes
gpu_oracle.camera_path: translation 0.005 times altitude and yaw 0.003 radians; six frames per on/off scene
gpu_oracle.reference: f64 source views and actual Depth32Float samples; independent of GPU uniform inverse and triangle identity
gpu_oracle.limits: Fixture bounds only. No general planetary depth precision, object motion, disocclusion or colour-history validation claim. Conservative mask may reject static geometry near water.

release_captures.baseline: same release binary with diagnostics off, not an unmodified parent executable
release_captures.limits: Four serial blocks only; scheduling, streaming and thermal noise not eliminated. Empty off interval still has timestamp overhead. No speedup or stable whole-frame regression claim. Equal patch counts are not resident-data identity; PNG hashes differ between processes and are not used as a pixel-parity oracle.
